ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.2.10 (TieJin Modify) 基于原模组 7 月停更时的 2.2.8 版本继续维护。 本次热修复：修复绑定仪式中断后无法继续日常调教的问题，恢复旧档残留状态，并防止重复结算。 完整中英双语更新记录见模组目录中的 CHANGELOG.md。
Continues development from the upstream 2.2.8 baseline. This hotfix restores daily training after interrupted Binding Rituals, repairs stale ritual state in older saves, and prevents duplicate outcomes. See CHANGELOG.md in the mod folder for the full Chinese and English release notes.
